description: Purchase a new phone number. This is a paid purchase that charges the account's balance, and requires confirm=true to actually go through. Returns the purchased number's details: its phone number, ID, country, and status.

agent_id.description: ID of an agent to attach the new number to right away (from list_agents or create_agent). Omit to leave the number unassigned.

area_code.description: A preferred area code so the number is local to a specific region (e.g. 415 for San Francisco). Omit to accept any available area code.

confirm.description: Must be true to complete the purchase. When false, no number is bought.

country.description: The country to buy the number in, as an ISO country code (for example US or CA).

name: buy_number

outputSchema.description: The purchased phone number, or a confirmation-required notice when confirm was false.

agentId.description: ID of the agent this number is assigned to, or null if unassigned.

confirmationRequired.description: True when the call only previewed the purchase; re-call with confirm=true to buy.

country.description: ISO country code the number belongs to.

id.description: The phone number's unique ID (use as number_id elsewhere).

phoneNumber.description: The number in E.164 format, e.g. +14155550123.

title: Buy Phone Number
